instruction: Which substantive criminal code governs offences committed in India post-July 1, 2024? (Query #1)

instruction: What is the statutory timeline for pronouncement of judgment after conclusion of trial under BNSS Section 392? (Rule #1)
output: Under BNSS Section 392, the judgment in every trial in any Criminal Court must be pronounced within 30 days after termination of trial, extendable up to 45 days for recorded reasons.

instruction: What is the maximum police custody period under BNSS Section 187? (Rule #2)
output: Under BNSS Section 187, police custody can be granted for up to 15 days in whole or in parts during the initial 40 or 60 days of the total detention period.

instruction: What relaxation does BNSS Section 479 grant to first-time undertrial prisoners? (Rule #3)
output: Under BNSS Section 479, a first-time offender who has never been previously convicted shall be released on bail if they have undergone detention for one-third of the maximum imprisonment period.
